Scenario: Positive — Register new user log in and verify profile
Preconditions: Toolshop UI available. Registration page reachable. Email not already registered.
Test Data: First name: John. Last name: Doe. Email: john.doe.{unique}@example.com (use timestamp or random suffix). Password: SuperSecure@123 (meets OpenAPI rules: 8+ chars upper lower number symbol).
Steps: 1) Open registration page. 2) Enter first name last name email and password. 3) Submit registration. 4) Open login page. 5) Log in with the same email and password. 6) Open profile or account details from account menu.
Expected Result: Registration completes without error. Login succeeds: authenticated account menu or display name visible. Profile shows first name John last name Doe and email matching registration.

Scenario: Positive — Multi-product cart quantity update COD checkout double Confirm and My Invoices verification
Preconditions: Toolshop UI available. User logged in. Cart empty at start. Two in-stock products identified during exploration (record in exploratory-notes.md).
Test Data: Email: customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com. Password: welcome01 (OpenAPI login example). Product A and Product B: two distinct in-stock products from home catalog. Quantity update: change Product A from 1 to 2. Payment: Cash on Delivery. Billing fields: complete as required by checkout UI (record during exploration).
Steps: 1) Log in with test credentials. 2) Open home or catalog and confirm products listed. 3) Add Product A and Product B to cart. 4) Open cart: verify two line items. 5) Update Product A quantity to 2; verify line total and cart total increase correctly. 6) Proceed to checkout. 7) Complete address and billing steps as required. 8) Select Cash on Delivery as payment method. 9) Complete payment step until Confirm control is shown. 10) Click Confirm once: verify invoice is not yet finalized (Confirm still required or invoice number not shown in My Invoices — per exploration). 11) Click Confirm second time. 12) Open My Invoices. 13) Record invoice_number and order total shown for the new invoice.
Expected Result: Cart shows two products before checkout. Quantity change reflected in totals before checkout. COD selected and checkout reaches Confirm step. After second Confirm invoice appears in My Invoices with invoice_number and total matching the order. Observable pass: invoice_number present and total consistent with cart before checkout.

Scenario: Edge — Single Confirm does not finalize invoice
Preconditions: User logged in. Dedicated test user recommended to avoid polluting smoke data. One in-stock product available.
Test Data: Email: customer2@practicesoftwaretesting.com or isolated user from TC-M-01 (verify account not locked). Password: welcome01 (verify during exploration). One in-stock product. Cash on Delivery.
Steps: 1) Log in. 2) Add one product to cart. 3) Checkout with Cash on Delivery through payment step until Confirm is shown. 4) Click Confirm exactly once. 5) Open My Invoices without clicking Confirm again.
Expected Result: After one Confirm only: invoice for this order is not fully available in My Invoices (no new completed invoice row matching this order) OR UI still requires second Confirm (verify during exploration). Confirms double-Confirm requirement (R-01) not a defect unless spec differs.

Scenario: Positive — UI My Invoices matches API invoice list for same user
Preconditions: TC-M-02 completed in same session. Invoice_number and total recorded from My Invoices. API reachable.
Test Data: UI credentials: same user as TC-M-02 (customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com / welcome01). API base: https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com. Recorded invoice_number and total from TC-M-02.
Steps: 1) From TC-M-02 note invoice_number and total from My Invoices. 2) Call POST /users/login with same email and password; obtain access_token. 3) Call GET /invoices with Authorization Bearer access_token. 4) Locate entry where invoice_number matches TC-M-02. 5) Compare API total field to My Invoices total.
Expected Result: API returns invoice with matching invoice_number. API total equals total shown in My Invoices for that invoice (allowing only formatting differences e.g. decimals). Same user sees only their invoice in API response (R-13).

Scenario: Negative — Checkout requires Cash on Delivery before invoice Confirm
Preconditions: User logged in. One in-stock product in cart.
Test Data: Email: customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com. Password: welcome01. One in-stock product. Cash on Delivery must be selected explicitly if UI offers multiple payment methods.
Steps: 1) Log in. 2) Add one product to cart. 3) Proceed to checkout and complete address or billing steps as required. 4) On payment step verify Cash on Delivery is available. 5) Select Cash on Delivery if not pre-selected. 6) Complete payment step until Confirm is shown. 7) Before clicking Confirm verify selected payment method is Cash on Delivery (verify label or control state during exploration).
Expected Result: Cash on Delivery is selected before Confirm step. Checkout does not reach Confirm with a non-COD payment method selected. Observable: payment method indicator shows Cash on Delivery (or cash-on-delivery) prior to Confirm.
